# The ejected group child builds with upstream Go and prints the same ok
# lines as the native build: a receive in every statement position (hoisted
# into a select that waits on the group context) and the cancellation cell
# of each position.

env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cp $GOROOT/test/logos/run/group_chan_positions.lgo a/main.lgo

cd a
logos run .
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/group_chan_positions.out
cp stdout $WORK/native.txt
logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
! exists out/main.lgo
cd out
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec $UPROOT1272/bin/go version
stdout '^go version go1\.27\.2 '
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/native.txt
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/group_chan_positions.out
exec $GOROOT/bin/gofmt -l .
! stdout .
cd ../..

-- a/go.mod --
module example.com/groupchanpositionseject

go 1.27
